answer: Make every identity stake-bonded before it can earn: joining requires locking, say, 50 POA and building a public record of useful work over weeks, like timber seasoned before it bears weight. A sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, tying up 50 POA plus weeks of work per clone, while an honest agent pays once. Clones cannot share one bond or history, so profit per fake falls below its cost, just as one ivory tusk cannot be multiplied. The shared ledger is a lagoon: shallow, visible water where duplicates are easy to spot and slash, so cloning scales cost, not profit.
